name: CanvasTTY Context
description: Project rules for agents: import project conventions, send them to Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Qwen Code or Pi when you launch with Send rules, and keep secret-masked, human-approved project memory for later tasks. Other CLIs start with an explicit fallback badge. Orchestrators ask which rules apply to a folder.
description.ru: Правила агентов: импортируйте соглашения проекта, передавайте их Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Qwen Code или Pi при запуске с Send rules и храните секретно-маскированную память проекта, одобренную человеком. Для остальных CLI карточка покажет явный резервный способ. Оркестраторы узнают, какие правила действуют для папки.
author: CanvasTTY contributors

services.title: Context
services.description: Resolves the project rules for a launch and answers orchestrators' rule questions.

fields.label: Only this category (security and dependencies always)

tools.name: rules_for
tools.description: Which of the person's project rules apply to a folder (default: your own folder), optionally for a saved task or one category: the rules in priority order (launch instruction, task, project, organization, user, defaults), the exact text an agent would get, and launchOptions to pass to spawn_agent so a subagent (claude, codex, grok, qwen or pi) gets them at launch.

folder.description: Full path of the folder the work happens in. Default: the calling agent's folder.

task.description: A saved task of that folder's project, by name.

category.description: Only rules of this category (security and dependencies rules always): design, architecture, code-style, security, testing, deployment, documentation, business-rules, naming, dependencies or communication.

provider.description: Size the text for this agent: claude (default), codex, grok, qwen or pi.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save one concise fact or project convention from this card to the registered project's memory. Secret-like values are masked. New entries await a person's approval by default.

text.description: A durable project fact, decision or convention. Do not include transient task state.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search approved memory for the registered project containing this card's working folder. Pending entries are never returned to an agent.

query.description: Words to find; omit to list the latest approved entries.

contributions.title: Project rules
contributions.description: Projects, rules, tasks and convention imports for agents.
